last_completed_unit.target: Cargo target.<triple>.<links> override effect on build-script compilation and build-dependencies
last_completed_unit.finding: Cargo source shows that a matching links override leaves the RunCustomBuild unit but compute_deps_custom_build returns no dependencies for it. That removes the normal dependency edge to the CustomBuild compilation unit and thus the build-dependency chain through this path. custom_build::prepare also detects preinserted override output and avoids build_work, so the build-script executable is not run.
last_completed_unit.verified_scope: Static inspection of rust-lang/cargo commit 8814ead110e36ed8fdcf1fdd4009baf82bd78523, src/compiler/unit_dependencies.rs and src/compiler/custom_build.rs; normal dependency-graph construction and overridden RunCustomBuild preparation only; no Cargo execution.
last_completed_unit.not_verified_scope: Actual cargo build test, all command modes, specific crates, independently-rooted CustomBuild units, native/generated artifact availability and parser-version portability.

source_scope: Current required repository controls for open_source, current own LATEST, SHA-only note-main freshness checks, and official rust-lang/cargo source only.
scope_guard: Do not generalize the normal-build source result into a claim that CustomBuild units can never appear under any Cargo command, or that links overrides replace native/generated artifacts or every build-script side effect.

frontier.current_target: Find a Cargo testsuite/source assertion that a links override prevents compilation of build.rs and its build-dependencies in an actual cargo build.
frontier.next_unit: After fresh required-control bootstrap and SHA-only head validation, inspect only official Cargo testsuite/source for a direct links-override test that observes build.rs/build-dependency compilation. If none exists, record the exact absence and identify the smallest public reproducible fixture without executing Cargo.

exact_continuation: On the next invocation, fresh-bootstrap and SHA-only validate current authority, then run one bounded official Cargo testsuite/source leaf to look for a test that demonstrates whether a target.<triple>.<links> override prevents compilation of the build.rs target and its build-dependencies in an actual cargo build. If no direct test exists, record that exact absence and identify the smallest public reproducible test fixture without executing Cargo. Keep native/generated artifacts, specific-crate correctness and broader command modes unresolved; do not start a second leaf.

hard_gate_assessment.residual_richer_mode_protected_user_exec: unresolved_for_end_to_end_validation_and_for_crates_requiring_artifacts_or_side effects not represented by override metadata
